### Definition of done
- [ ] Man pages updated **first** and reviewed
- [ ] Acceptance criteria met and demonstrated
- [ ] Ticket's laws green; ledger updated
- [ ] Formal models touching this area still check; state names still match
- [ ] New guardrail tests mutation-checked once (break the rule, watch it fail)
- [ ] Regression tests for every new error path and bug fixed
- [ ] Dependency rule passes; no vendor import in `internal/core`
- [ ] No secrets, prompts or content in logs (scanner green)
- [ ] Devlog entry added; changelog, bugs, risks updated if relevant
- [ ] Two reviewers if this touches policy, audit, toolbus, approvals, actions, release, proofs or the eval gate
